overview_description.description: Thera develops custom web, e-commerce, and business software solutions. Its services include requirements analysis, technical feasibility studies, software design, implementation, testing, deployment, maintenance, and manual quality assurance. The company builds online and on-premise business applications, web shops, event websites, real estate portals, and web and mobile systems for operational workflows. It uses technologies including Next.js, Strapi, PostgreSQL, GatsbyJS, Node.js, AstroJS, and React Native.
